description: This file defines the TableArg class in PySpark, providing methods to specify partitioning, ordering, and single-partition constraints for table arguments in Spark SQL functions.

classes.name: TableArg
classes.description: Represents a table argument in PySpark with methods to partition, order, and constrain data for table-valued functions.

methods.name: partitionBy
methods.description: Defines how to partition data based on specified columns before processing in a table-valued function.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Specifies the ordering of data within each partition.

methods.name: withSinglePartition
methods.description: Forces all data to be processed as a single partition.
